notes: Seed taxonomy v1 from the sift spec §3, plus `structured_data` (text), the file_* fallbacks, and the v1.2 granular additions (tracking_number, otp_code, address, todo_list, image_tags). Each category: id, modality, threshold (per-category confidence floor, spec §7.2), relic_tags (what the ingest layer writes into Relic.tags — see docs/sift-integration.md), clip_prompts (zero-shot label strings for the image classifier, spec §6.2), prototypes (example texts embedded once to form the text head's class centroids, spec §6.1). Built-in relic_tags are single lowercase words on purpose: FTS5 column-filter syntax (`tags:foo`) only takes an unquoted bare token, so hyphenated tags would force users to type `tags:"foo-bar"`. (Hyphens are still legal — user-rule tags may have them — they just need quoting in column queries.) image_tags is a multi-label bank: each tag scores its prompts against background_prompts in the same CLIP pass; winners above threshold become extra relic tags, not categories.
